notes.title: UPDATE - Famous EDM Tracks with Community System
notes.notes:
[b]Dear STUMPER Players and EDM Fans[/b],

[b]STUMPER[/b], the 1st VR rhythm game with battle support, will bring you more [b]FUN [/b]and [b]EXCITEMENT[/b] on [b]SEP 30 (PST)[/b].

[b]1. Trendy EDM Tracks[/b] from 2 Famous Artists in ASIA: [i][b]FENNER & DASHIWA[/b][/i]

The 8 new tracks will add even more variety to our own music library, while drawing more music fans' attention as they featured other famous musicians from different genres such as Morcheeba, DJ Soda, and Part Time Cooks.
[list]
[b][*] Fenner, Soda & Kryoman - Butterfly (Lost Chameleon Remix)
[*] Morcheeba - Its Summertime (Fenner & Quazzer Remix)
[*] Fenner - Pray For Me ft. Part Time Cooks
[*] Fenner & Ferry - Drop The Bazz
[*] DASHIWA- Here With Me ft. UZA
[*] DASHIWA - A Monkey Stole My Cookie
[*] DASHIWA - Bella
[*] DASHIWA - Rxless ft. Part Time Cooks[/b]
[/list]
[previewyoutube=ANgodqpsr7s;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ANgodqpsr7s[/previewyoutube]

[b]2. Community System Update[/b]

[b]Community System[/b]
- Friends List (Add/Delete)
- Friends Status (Offline/ Lobby / Playing)
- Battle Request 
- Join the Battle Room Created by Your Friends

[b]User Details[/b]
- Click on the User ID on Ranking or Friends List
- Single Play: Global Ranking, Each Rank Count
- Battle Play: Winning Rate, Win/Draw/Lost Count
- ETC: Play Count, Joining Date

[b]3. 9 Different Languages Added[/b]

- Simplified Chinese
- Traditional Chinese
- Japanese
- Korean
- German
- French
- Russian
- Spanish
- Portuguese

[b]NOW, STUMPER TIME!!![/b]

notes.title: STUMPER v1.0.4 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Dear STUMPER Players, 

Finally, we've added an option to change shield color for those who have decreased ability to distinguish certain shades of color or those who simply would love to enjoy our game in various color setting. 

You can just go to Option and turn on/off Color Weakness Mode. On Color Weakness Mode, red shiled will be changed to yellow and purple to white. 

We truly appreciate your feedback and look forward to hearing more! Please note that our Discord channel and Steam discussion are always open for you. 

And if you are located in North America, also check out our SUBPAC M2 sweepstake on Facebook! 
🔉 STUMPER Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Stumper-373998070105479/


NOW STUMPER PLAYTIME!

notes.title: STUMPER v1.0.2 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Dear STUMPER players, 

We're excited to be releasing v1.02. Thank you for all your attention to STUMPER. We are listening to our players' voice and working on the game to be improved. 

Here's what we updated: 
- Added rematch feature on battle mode
- Improved graphics performance on single mode
- Fixed an issue of missing crystals when frame drop was severe
- Fixed an issue of error message on binding option showed up

We are always thankful for your feedback. Don't hesitate to share your feedback on STUMPER with us.

Now let's enjoy STUMPER!

notes.title: STUMPER v1.0.1 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Dear STUMPER players, 

It's good to say hello with some bug fixed and some stuff added. First, thank you for all your attention to STUMPER. We are listening to our players' voice and working on the game to be improved. 

Here's what we updated: 

- Added LIV Mixed Reality software to capture yourself in VR
- Made sure we have 17 songs in the game 
- Fixed an issue of frame-drops in the lobby and game intro
- Added Visualizer(in-stage effect) On/Off option 
- Fixed to record a player's score when he or she clears a stage(or a song) on standby in the battle mode
- Fixed the bug that interrupted synchronization between players on battle mode.
- Moved Anti-aliasing option to graphics quality item

Your feedback is really helpful to improve our game. Don't hesitate to share your feedback on STUMPER with us.

Now let's enjoy STUMPER.
